crossRefs.keyword: wilt ease thyself. Heb. sittest down. cover that

translations.web: You shall have a trowel among your weapons. It shall be, when you relieve yourself, you shall dig with it, and shall turn back and cover your excrement;
translations.bsb: And you must have a digging tool in your equipment so that when you relieve yourself you can dig a hole and cover up your excrement.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt have a paddle upon thy weapon; and it shall be, when thou wilt ease thyself abroad, thou shalt dig therewith, and shalt turn back and cover that which cometh
translations.asv: and thou shalt have a paddle among thy weapons; and it shall be, when thou sittest down abroad, thou shalt dig therewith, and shalt turn back and cover that which cometh from thee:
